name: lpu_sram
label: LPU (SRAM only)
philosophy: No DRAM: all weights/state resident in on-chip SRAM, scale-out across many chips.

spill.note: host memory over PCIe; only for CPU-trace spill

calibration_note: op_overhead_us and hop latency chosen so Llama-3.1-8B/70B batch-1 decode lands near publicly reported token rates for this class of system; per-op synchronisation and pipeline latency are not otherwise modelled
